metadata.description:
Covid-19 has devastated most of the indian cities in the last two months. But now, it is dangerously spreading to rural India, and has even reached tribal areas. The government of India has issued a special Covid SOP for the Tribal areas of the country. 
What are the challenges in dealing with covid-19 in rural and tribal areas? What needs to be done to stop the spread? 
We try to understand the issue and answer these questions in this interview with Dr Rajib Dasgupta, who works in community medicine in JNU.
